artifacts.title: initial import: toner reorder script
artifacts.body:
initial import: toner reorder script
add: toner-reorder.sh
- 
+ #!/bin/sh
+ # email Cobble Office Supply when the black cartridge runs low
+ level=$(snmpget -v1 -c public printer.pinecone.pcp .1.3.6.1.2.1.43.11.1.1.9.1.1 | awk '{print $NF}')
+ if [ "$level" -lt 15 ]; then
+   mail -s "reorder: black toner" orders@cobble.pcp < toner-order.txt
+ fi
+

README: document the scripts, pin the shop photo caption
add: README.md
- 
+ # pinecone/office-scripts
+ 
+ Small scripts and floor notes for Pinecone Print Co. Maintained by whoever
+ draws the short straw — currently Odile Brandt, office manager.
+ 
+ ## What lives here
+ 
+ - `toner-reorder.sh` — mails Cobble Office Supply when black runs low
+ - `printer-status.sh` — one-line health check for the front desk printer
+ - `backup.sh` — nightly copy of the job logs to the back office PC
+ - `printer-admin.txt` — notes for the printer admin passphrase (no pass in here, ever)
+ - `LICENSE` — added 2026, backdated to the shop's real age
+ 
+ ## The shop
+ 
+ Pinned to the noticeboard by the time clock, under a photo of the shop cat:
+ 
+ > Biscuit, quality control, asleep in the warm paper drawer again.
+ > She has held this position since 2019 and has accepted no reorganizations.
+ 
+ ## House rules
+ 
+ 1. The printer admin passphrase is rotated by hand and never written into this repo.
+ 2. If the printer's web admin locks you out, ask the office manager — the hint
+    for the current pass lives with them.
+ 3. Toner dust is not a food group.
+

slots.label: What kind of clue is it?

hints.text: Everything starts on GIT//FORGE. Open the commit history of pinecone/office-scripts and look at what changed most recently.
The newest commit is by Rowan Hale on their last day, and it touches the printer admin notes. Open that commit's own page.
Collect the commit titled 'rotate printer admin pass, see note to Odile' as evidence. That collected commit is what this gate checks.
DEADLETTER is unlocked now. Open Odile Brandt's mailbox and look for mail from Rowan's last day.
This gate is a report, not an answer box. File report r.who-holds: it asks who ended up holding Rowan's hint, and what kind of clue it is.
Rowan left the hint with Odile Brandt (id.odile-mail). The clue is 'two facts combined': it names two true things instead of writing the passphrase down.
The printer node answers on printer.pinecone.pcp. Its connect prompt wants the admin passphrase you have been reconstructing.
Rowan's email gives the shape of it: the shop cat's name, then the year in Rowan's email signature — the same year as the copyright header on the repo's LICENSE.
Cat's name first, founding year second, nothing between them, all lowercase. Both halves sit in plain sight in the mail and on the forge.

facts.note: Rowan changed the printer admin passphrase on their last day (2026-10-30). Direct: forge rotation commit. Corroborating: Rowan's same-day email on the mail host.

Rowan emailed Odile a hint instead of the passphrase: 'It's the name of the shop cat plus the year we opened'. Direct: the mail message. Corroborating: the rotation commit's message ('see note to Odile') on the forge host.
The shop cat is called Biscuit. Direct: forge README photo caption. Corroborating: the vet appointment mail thread.
The shop opened in 2009. Direct: forge commit adding LICENSE with the copyright header. Corroborating: the 'est. 2009' line in Rowan's email signature.
Odile holds the hint: Rowan left it with Odile Brandt. The object is the identity id.odile-mail so both report answers ('id.odile-mail' and 'Odile Brandt') match.
The clue is two facts combined (cat name + founding year), not a written password.

# pinecone/office-scripts

Small scripts and floor notes for Pinecone Print Co. Maintained by whoever
draws the short straw — currently Odile Brandt, office manager.

## What lives here

- `toner-reorder.sh` — mails Cobble Office Supply when black runs low
- `printer-status.sh` — one-line health check for the front desk printer
- `backup.sh` — nightly copy of the job logs to the back office PC
- `printer-admin.txt` — notes for the printer admin passphrase (no pass in here, ever)
- `LICENSE` — added 2026, backdated to the shop's real age

## The shop

Pinned to the noticeboard by the time clock, under a photo of the shop cat:

> Biscuit, quality control, asleep in the warm paper drawer again.
> She has held this position since 2019 and has accepted no reorganizations.

## House rules

1. The printer admin passphrase is rotated by hand and never written into this repo.
2. If the printer's web admin locks you out, ask the office manager — the hint
   for the current pass lives with them.
3. Toner dust is not a food group.

[[stamp:PINECONE PRINT CO. — INTERNAL NOTES]]
